facts.activity_file: removing isolation and returning to operations

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of CV-3101 during commissioning of replacement equipment

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on CV-3101 and M-3101 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CV-3101 and M-3101 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on CV-3101 and M-3101 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. CV-3101 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 19 December 2022 an incident occurred on CV-3101 and M-3101 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
